01 — Abstract

A New Social Economy

Drops App is a next-generation social platform where content creation, genuine engagement, and community participation are the primary sources of economic reward. Every post, interaction, tip, live call, and contribution builds a user's standing on the platform, and that standing directly governs how much they earn and how fast their rewards become liquid. This economy is powered by DROPS, a deflationary utility token on BNB Smart Chain with a fixed maximum supply of 100,000,000 tokens.

Core Proposition

Traditional social platforms generate billions of dollars in revenue from user attention and data while returning nothing to the people who create that value, while routinely censoring, shadow-banning, or deplatforming users without due process. Drops App redesigns this relationship entirely. Users participate in a platform where genuine engagement generates real economic reward, content moderation is driven by the community rather than corporate algorithms, and zero-censorship is a foundational principle, not a promise. Platform revenue drives token demand, and deflationary mechanics protect the value of every token in circulation for users and holders alike.

For Users

Earn DROPS by creating content, engaging with the community, hosting live sessions, receiving tips, and completing platform tasks. Your activity rank, computed continuously by the platform algorithm, determines your earning rate and how quickly your balance becomes liquid. Mining sessions provide a supplementary amplification layer on top of activity-based rewards.

For Investors

A fixed-supply token (100M DROPS, no additional minting) with real utility demand across six spending categories, built-in burn mechanics on every major fee, and a dual-balance system that meters sell pressure as the user base scales.

For the Ecosystem

A multi-revenue platform generating income from social interactions, mining boosts, campaigns, cashout fees, and a forthcoming marketplace, with each revenue stream reinforcing token demand and funding platform sustainability.

02 — The Problem

What Is Broken About Social Media

The global social media industry generated over $200 billion in advertising revenue in 2023. The users who produced the content that attracted that advertising received none of it. This is the foundational problem Drops App is designed to solve.

Users Are the Product, Not the Beneficiary

Platforms like Meta and TikTok monetise user attention through advertising and data licensing. In 2023, Meta generated approximately $134 per user annually in revenue. Users received no share of this despite being the sole source of the content that generates it.

Censorship, Shadow-Banning, and Algorithmic Control

On most platforms, a single moderator or automated algorithm can silently suppress a creator's reach, remove their content, or ban their account entirely, with no transparent process, no community input, and no meaningful right of appeal. Shadow-banning removes visibility without even notifying the user it has happened. This unchecked censorship power creates a hostile environment where creators self-censor rather than express freely.

No True Ownership of Content or Audience

Creator accounts are suspended without appeal. Algorithmic reach is throttled arbitrarily. Monetisation programmes are revoked at the platform's discretion. Content is deleted silently on schedules users never agreed to and were never told about. Users build audiences on infrastructure they do not own and cannot transfer, leaving them with fragile, platform-dependent careers.

Inflationary Earn-to-Use Experiments

Prior platforms with token economies introduced supply without controls, activity requirements, or real utility. Tokens mined freely with no burn mechanism and no demand drivers collapsed in value as supply outpaced organic demand. Users earned tokens worth progressively less over time.

Bot Farming and Passive Exploitation

Any earn-while-using model without activity requirements becomes vulnerable to bot farming: automated accounts that drain token supply without contributing genuine social value, harming real users and degrading token economics for everyone.

03 — Our Vision

A Platform That Works For You

Drops App is built on a single principle: participation should create lasting value. Every feature generates either platform revenue, token demand, or user reward, and in most cases, all three simultaneously.

The Core Loop

Users join and earn DROPS by creating content, engaging with the community, and participating in platform activity. Their participation score governs their earning rate and Earning Balance release speed. They spend DROPS to amplify reach, access premium features, and boost mining output. Spending creates platform revenue and reduces token supply. A healthier economy attracts more users, more activity, more demand, more burns. The loop compounds over time.

Zero-Censorship by Design

Drops App is built on a zero-censorship philosophy. No algorithm suppresses content. No moderator shadow-bans a user invisibly. No corporate decision silences a creator. Content moderation on Drops App is entirely community-driven: users report, the community of ambassadors votes, and decisions escalate through a transparent governance process before any action is taken. As the platform scales, this model evolves into a full DAO (Decentralized Autonomous Organization) where the community holds direct governance power over moderation standards. Freedom of expression and community sovereignty are non-negotiable values at every stage of the platform's development.

Why Drops is Different

Many projects have tried to reward users for social activity. Most have failed for the same predictable reasons. Drops App is designed specifically to avoid each of them.

Why Others Failed

  • Unlimited token minting with no supply cap — inflation destroyed value
  • Earn-only models with no mandatory spend — zero demand engine
  • Immediate full liquidity at settlement — mass dump at every payout window
  • Single revenue stream — platform collapsed when that stream dried up
  • Corporate moderation driving creator exodus — no trust, no retention
  • Passive rewards with no activity requirement — bot farms drained supply

How Drops Solves Each One

  • Fixed 100M supply — no minting ever. Scarcity is permanent and provable
  • Mandatory spend loops — boosts, subscriptions, and campaigns require ongoing DROPS outflow
  • Dual-balance metering — earned tokens convert gradually, preventing dump waves
  • Three revenue categories — Social, Economy, and Marketplace provide independent income streams
  • Community-governed, zero-censorship — no platform authority to alienate creators
  • Activity score requirement — passive accounts earn significantly less; bots cannot exploit the model

The Competitive Edge in One Sentence

Drops App combines real social utility with a structured token economy that earns, spends, burns, and governs, with every system specifically designed to prevent the failure modes that have destroyed every comparable project before it.

04 — The Platform

Features Built for Real People

Drops App is a complete social platform. Every feature is designed to create meaningful interactions, and each interaction is connected to the DROPS economy in a way that benefits users, not just the platform.

Social Feed

Chronological and algorithmic feed for text, image, and video posts. Follow other users, repost content, and build a public profile. Creators can boost posts using DROPS to expand reach beyond their existing audience, with transparent pricing per boost duration. Every post displays its current lifecycle status so users always know the state of their content.

Drop Calls — Live Audio and Video

Live audio and video rooms open to all users. Any user can join as a listener at no cost. Only verified badge holders can create a Drop Call or speak as a participant during one, making verification the gateway to hosting and active voice participation. Listeners can tip hosts and speakers directly during a session using DROPS, creating a real-time creator revenue stream driven entirely by audience engagement.

Tipping and Peer-to-Peer Transfers

Send DROPS directly to any user on the platform at zero cost; peer-to-peer transfers carry no platform fee. Tips are also free to send. When a tip is received, the creator takes 80% of the tipped amount; 10% is automatically credited to the creator's referrer as a bonus, and the remaining 10% flows into the Community Reward Pool. This ensures every tip strengthens both the creator's income and the broader ecosystem simultaneously.

Verified Membership & Premium Subscription

Verification is a monthly DROPS subscription that grants a verified badge, elevated visibility in search and recommendations, access to exclusive premium features, and higher trust standing across the platform. Verified users also keep their posts permanently public with no lifecycle countdown — a meaningful operational advantage for creators who build long-term content libraries. A Merchant and Organisation badge tier is planned for a later phase, designed for businesses, brands, and registered entities seeking a distinct presence on the platform.

Promotional Campaigns and Tasks

Brands, creators, and businesses create follow campaigns, post-link campaigns, and custom task campaigns using DROPS. Users who complete valid campaign tasks earn DROPS rewards. The platform collects a service fee from the campaign creator, and a portion is returned to the community reward pool.

Private Messaging

End-to-end encrypted direct messaging between users. Messages are encrypted on the sender's device using AES-256-GCM before transmission. The platform stores only ciphertext; plaintext content is never accessible to Drops App or any third party, including in the event of a data breach.

Ambassador Programme

Community ambassadors earn bonus rewards for onboarding new users and driving platform growth. Referral bonuses are paid as a percentage of the referred user's mining rewards, incentivising ambassadors to recruit active participants rather than dormant accounts.

Content Lifecycle Management

Most platforms handle old content in one of two ways: keep everything forever with no regard for what is still relevant, or delete it quietly on an internal schedule the user never saw or agreed to. Neither approach respects the user. Drops takes a different position.

The Core Principle: No Post Disappears Without Your Knowledge

Every post on Drops has a visible lifecycle status. As content approaches the end of its default public window, the platform notifies you in advance — giving you time to make a deliberate choice about what happens next. Archive it, keep it live, or remove it. The decision belongs to you. The platform never acts silently.

Active

Publicly visible and discoverable. All posts start here. The status remains active for 90 days from publication, or indefinitely for verified users.

Archived

Removed from the public feed but never deleted. Archived posts remain fully accessible to the owner — they can be viewed, downloaded, reposted as new content, or restored to active at any time.

Permanent

No countdown. No notifications. Posts with permanent status stay publicly visible indefinitely. Available to verified badge holders and via direct DROPS spend for individual posts.

All Users

  • Notified before any post approaches its public window
  • Can archive, restore, or delete their own content at any time
  • Can repost archived content as a fresh active post
  • Can spend DROPS to extend a post's visibility by 30 days
  • Full access to their complete post history, active or archived

Verified Badge Holders

  • All posts remain permanently public — no 90-day countdown
  • Can restore archived posts directly back to the public feed
  • Higher character limits and media upload allowances
  • Priority ranking in feed and content discovery

DROPS and Content Control

Users who want more flexibility without a full verification subscription can use DROPS to act on individual posts. Spending DROPS extends a post's public window, restores an archived post to the active feed, or permanently unlocks a single post's visibility status. Every action is voluntary, user-initiated, and confirmed before any DROPS are spent. The platform never charges automatically or takes action on content without the user's knowledge.

05 — Content Moderation

Community-Governed. Zero-Censorship.

Drops App does not operate a top-down, corporate-controlled moderation system. There is no algorithm that silently suppresses content. There is no shadow-banning. No single moderator or executive can unilaterally remove a user's content or restrict their reach without community involvement. Moderation on Drops App is purely community-driven: transparent, accountable, and governed by the users themselves.

The Zero-Censorship Commitment

Zero-censorship is not a slogan; it is an architectural principle. Drops App enforces no political, ideological, or algorithmic content filtering. No content is shadow-banned. No reach is secretly throttled. The only content subject to community review is content that is reported by users. Unreported content is never touched. Users speak freely, and the community, not the platform, decides what crosses a line.

How Moderation Works — The Community Vote System

User Reports Any user flags content

›

Ambassadors Alerted All moderators notified

›

Community Vote Ambassadors vote on the report

›

Admin Review Vote result escalated to admin

›

Decision Issued Action taken per vote outcome

Step 1 — User Report

Any user on the platform can flag content they believe violates the Community Guidelines. Reports are categorised by type (harassment, harmful content, impersonation, spam, or other) to route them appropriately. Submitting a report in bad faith is itself a guideline violation and subject to community review.

Step 2 — Ambassador Alert

When a report is submitted, all active ambassadors (community moderators) on the platform are notified simultaneously. Ambassadors are trusted, established community members who have earned their moderator status through long-term platform engagement and community recognition rather than appointment by the platform.

Step 3 — Community Vote

Ambassadors independently review the reported content in context and cast their vote. There is no single point of decision; the outcome is determined by the collective judgement of the community. Votes are recorded and transparent to the review chain. The vote result reflects what the community as a whole believes is appropriate action.

Step 4 — Admin Decision

Once the ambassador vote reaches threshold, the report and full vote record are escalated to the platform admin team. The admin team acts according to the community's voted outcome; they are not overriding the community, but executing its decision. This preserves accountability at scale while ensuring legal and safety obligations are met.

Roadmap to Full DAO Governance

The current ambassador-vote system is the foundation for a fully decentralized moderation governance model. As the platform scales, Drops App is committed to evolving this into a DAO (Decentralized Autonomous Organization) structure where DROPS token holders participate directly in setting and amending community standards, electing moderators, and reviewing governance decisions. No central authority will retain unilateral control. The community governs itself.

No Bots, No Automated Banning

Drops App does not use automated systems to ban accounts or remove content based on keyword detection, engagement patterns, or algorithmic scoring. No account is suspended, restricted, or shadow-banned by an automated process. Every enforcement action that affects a user's account requires a completed community vote and admin confirmation, with no exceptions outside of the technical CSAM filter described below.

Community Guidelines

All users agree to the Drops App Community Guidelines on account creation. These define the narrow set of content types that the community may vote to act upon — including content that sexualises minors, content that coordinates real-world violence against specific individuals, and coordinated platform manipulation. Outside these defined categories, the Community Guidelines do not restrict opinion, expression, or content type. Zero-censorship is the default state.

CSAM — The Only Automated Technical Exception

Child sexual abuse material (CSAM) is the single category where automated technical screening applies. Uploaded content is hash-matched against known CSAM databases using PhotoDNA-compatible comparison at the point of upload — before it is ever stored or visible to any user. This is a legal obligation under applicable law, not a censorship mechanism. Any confirmed CSAM match results in immediate escalation to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC) as required by law, and immediate account termination with no community vote required.

Minor Safety

Drops App requires users to confirm they are 16 years of age or older at account creation. Users under 18 are subject to additional content access restrictions. DROPS token features (including mining, boosting, and cashout) are restricted to users who have completed the platform's identity confirmation process.

Transparency Reporting

Drops App publishes a semi-annual Transparency Report covering the volume of community reports received, ambassador votes cast, admin decisions issued, appeal outcomes, and any law enforcement data requests received and responded to. The report is published publicly and in full. The community deserves to see exactly how its governance system is working.

06 — Security & Data Safety

Built to Be Trusted

Security and user privacy are foundational design requirements, not optional additions. Drops App is built on a minimal-data, minimal-permissions philosophy: the app only knows what you choose to share, and only accesses your device when a specific feature genuinely requires it.

Device Permissions — Minimal by Design

We Request Only What Is Necessary

Drops App requests exactly two device permissions. Nothing more. No location access, no contacts, no background sensors, no camera roll. File uploads such as profile pictures or post attachments are always user-initiated through the standard system file picker; the app never accesses your storage unprompted.

🔔

Device Notifications

Used to alert you when your mining session settles, when you receive a message or tip, or when a Drop Call you follow goes live. You can disable notifications at any time in your device settings; this does not affect any core app functionality.

🎙️

Microphone — Drop Calls Only

Requested only when you actively join or host a live Drop Call (audio or video session). The microphone is never accessed outside of an active call. When the call ends, microphone access is released immediately and is not held in the background.

Platform Security

End-to-End Encrypted Messaging

All private messages are encrypted on the sender's device using AES-256-GCM before transmission. Encryption keys are derived per-conversation. Drops App servers store only ciphertext; no message content is readable by the platform, its employees, or any third party, including in the event of a server-side data breach. Messages cannot be decrypted retroactively without the sender's or recipient's private key material.

Account Authentication and Session Security

Passwords are protected using bcrypt hashing with a minimum cost factor of 12. Optional two-factor authentication (2FA) is available using time-based one-time passwords (TOTP). All authenticated sessions are issued short-lived JWT tokens. Failed login attempts are rate-limited and trigger account lockout after repeated failures to prevent brute-force attacks.

On-Chain Transparency

All DROPS token transactions — transfers, burns, cashouts, boost purchases — are recorded on BNB Smart Chain and publicly verifiable on BscScan. The token contract address, total supply, burn address balance, and transaction history are permanently accessible to any party without requiring permission from Drops App. Platform-stated burn figures and supply claims are independently auditable at all times.

Infrastructure Security

Platform infrastructure is hosted on cloud providers with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certifications. All data in transit is encrypted using TLS 1.3. All data at rest is encrypted using AES-256. Database access is restricted to application service accounts with least-privilege permissions. Regular automated vulnerability scanning and penetration testing are conducted by independent security firms.

Data Collection and User Privacy

What We Collect

  • Account registration data — username, email address, and date of birth, used solely for account creation and age verification
  • Profile information you add yourself — display name, bio, profile picture, and any other details you voluntarily enter for your social presence. This is information you choose to share, stored and displayed exactly as you provide it
  • Session and activity logs — used for mining reward calculation, platform health monitoring, and content moderation purposes only
  • Transaction records — required for ledger integrity, dispute resolution, and regulatory compliance

What We Do Not Do

  • We do not access your microphone outside of active Drop Calls
  • We do not request access to your location, contacts, or device storage
  • We do not sell user data to advertisers or data brokers
  • We do not read, scan, or train AI models on private message content
  • We do not share user financial data with third parties without legal compulsion
  • We do not use behavioural tracking for targeted advertising
  • We do not retain deleted account data beyond the legally required minimum retention period

User Rights and Data Control

Users have the following rights with respect to their data, exercisable at any time through the platform or by written request to the privacy team:

  • Right of access — request a full export of all data held on your account
  • Right of rectification — correct inaccurate personal information held on your profile
  • Right of erasure — request permanent deletion of your account and associated personal data, subject to legal retention requirements for financial transaction records
  • Right to data portability — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
  • Right to object — object to any processing of your personal data not required for platform operation

07 — Revenue Streams

Three Revenue Categories

Drops App generates revenue across three clearly defined categories. Each creates token demand, platform income, or both, forming a diversified and resilient economic model that does not depend on a single revenue source.

Social Peer-to-peer activity generating platform fees

Tips

Tips are free to send. The creator receives 80% of every tip. 10% is credited automatically to the creator's referrer as an ongoing bonus, and 10% flows into the Community Reward Pool, ensuring every tip strengthens the ecosystem alongside the creator.

Post and Profile Boosts

Users spend DROPS to promote posts in the feed or boost profile visibility in search results. Boost fees are partially burned and partially returned to the reward pool.

Verified Membership Subscription

A recurring monthly DROPS subscription granting a verified badge, elevated platform visibility, and access to premium features. Subscription revenue funds platform operations and the Community Reward Pool. A Merchant and Organisation badge tier is planned for a later phase.

Drop Calls

Live audio and video rooms monetised entirely through tipping. Listeners tip hosts and speakers directly during a session using DROPS. The host retains the majority of each tip; the platform takes a small commission. Access to listen is always free; only verified badge holders can create or speak, making verification the gateway to hosting revenue.

Content Lifecycle Actions

Users spend DROPS to extend a post's public visibility window, restore archived content to the feed, or permanently unlock individual posts. These are user-initiated, optional actions — each one generating a small platform fee while giving users direct control over their content without requiring a full verified subscription.

Economy Token-driven mechanics sustaining the platform economy

Mining Boost Purchases

Users spend DROPS to increase their mining earning potential. Boost purchases are the primary recurring demand driver for DROPS. A portion of each boost fee is burned; the remainder funds the mining reward pool.

Cashout Fees

When users convert earned DROPS to external currency, a cashout fee is applied. This fee discourages immediate extraction, generates platform operating revenue, and reduces the liquid supply exiting the ecosystem.

Promotional Campaigns

Brands and creators pay DROPS to run targeted follow and engagement campaigns. The platform earns a service fee on every campaign; participants earn DROPS rewards for completing valid tasks.

Ambassador and Referral Bonuses

Referral chains create compounding network growth. Referrers earn 5% of their referral's mining rewards for each session, incentivising sustainable, activity-based recruitment rather than dormant signups.

Marketplace Coming Soon

Creator Stores

Creators sell digital products, exclusive content packs, and subscriptions directly through the app. DROPS is the payment layer. The platform takes a transaction fee on every completed sale.

Escrow-Protected Trades

Peer-to-peer trades with built-in escrow settlement. A platform fee is charged on every completed transaction to cover dispute resolution and trust guarantees. Funds are released on mutual confirmation or moderator decision.

AI-Powered Tools

Content creation, editing, and discovery tools powered by AI, available as consumable features paid in DROPS. Creates a consistent, recurring spend category as users access capabilities on demand.

Revenue Sharing

A defined percentage of all marketplace transaction fees flows into the Community Reward Pool, distributing platform commercial success back to the most active and verified participants.

The Marketplace is in active development and will launch in a phased rollout. Early access will be granted to verified accounts and high-activity users first.

08 — Earning Model

How You Earn on Drops

Drops App rewards genuine participation above everything else. Content creation, community engagement, live sessions, and real social activity are the primary drivers of earning on the platform. Mining sessions serve as a supplementary amplification layer that enhances rewards earned through active participation, not a replacement for it. Passive accounts earn significantly less regardless of any other factor.

08.1 — The Participation Score Algorithm

The Engine Behind Every Reward and Release

At the core of the Drops economy is a continuously running participation scoring algorithm. Every user on the platform is scored in real time based on the breadth and quality of their engagement. This score is not cosmetic — it is the governing variable that determines how much a user earns from platform activity, how fast their Earning Balance is released for use, and what share of platform revenue distributions they are eligible for. The algorithm cannot be gamed by passive presence or time alone. Only genuine, diverse participation moves the score meaningfully upward.

What the Algorithm Tracks

Content & Creative Activity

  • Posts and content published to the feed
  • Comments contributed to discussions
  • Reactions and engagement given to other users' content
  • Content reposts and shares that drive reach for other creators

Community & Economic Activity

  • Tips sent to other creators — rewarding generosity and community support
  • Tips received — reflecting the creator's value to their audience
  • Verified badge held — signals commitment to the platform
  • Referrals brought in — expanding the active community

Live & Campaign Participation

  • Drop Call hosting — demonstrating platform leadership
  • Drop Call attendance and speaker participation
  • Campaign tasks completed — contributing to creator ecosystems
  • Campaign creation — investing in platform growth

Consistency Signal

  • Regularity of participation — consistent daily activity scores higher than sporadic bursts
  • Breadth of activity — engagement across multiple categories outperforms single-dimension participation
  • Recency weighting — recent activity carries more weight than historical peaks

What the Score Determines

Earning Balance Release Rate — The Primary Output

The Participation Score is the primary governor of how fast a user's Earning Balance converts to spendable Token Balance. Higher-ranked users see a larger percentage of their Earning Balance eligible for release in each distribution period. Lower-ranked or inactive users face slower conversion — their earned DROPS accumulate but unlock at a reduced pace. This is the platform's most direct meritocratic mechanism: the more genuinely you participate, the faster your rewards become liquid.

Revenue Distribution Share

A portion of platform revenue (drawn from campaign fees, subscription income, Drop Call commissions, and transaction fees) is periodically distributed back to the active community. The Participation Score determines each eligible user's proportional share of this distribution. Top-ranked contributors receive the largest share. This creates a direct financial incentive to be a genuine, active member of the platform rather than a passive holder.

Mining Session Reward Modifier

When a user runs a mining session, their Participation Score applies as a multiplier to the base session reward. A highly active user running the same session as a low-activity user earns measurably more at settlement, not because they paid more, but because the platform has verified they contribute genuine value. This is why mining alone, without activity, produces significantly reduced output.

Why This Model Matters

Most earn-to-use platforms distribute rewards based purely on time or capital invested. Drops App distributes based on value contributed. A user who posts daily, tips creators, hosts live sessions, and brings in referrals will always out-earn a user who simply holds tokens and runs mining sessions passively, regardless of which one has been on the platform longer. This is the meritocratic foundation that separates Drops from every previous attempt at a social token economy.

08.2 — Activity-Based Earning (Primary)

Activity earning is available to every user from day one, at no cost. There is no subscription, no purchase, and no threshold to clear before it begins. The platform records every eligible action, scores it, and factors it into the next distribution cycle automatically.

"No activity, no tokens."

The Drops economy rewards contribution, not presence. Passive accounts earn nothing; the algorithm only recognises value delivered to the community.

What Earns

  • Creating posts and content that receive engagement
  • Commenting on and engaging with other users' content
  • Tipping other creators — contributing to the community economy
  • Receiving tips — your audience rewarding your content
  • Hosting or participating in Drop Calls
  • Completing campaign tasks from brands and creators
  • Referring active new users who participate on the platform

What Does Not Earn

  • Holding tokens passively
  • Creating an account and not participating
  • Repetitive low-quality engagement (detected and scored low)
  • Bot-generated or scripted activity (excluded from scoring)
  • Referring users who remain inactive after joining

08.3 — Mining Sessions (Supplementary Amplification)

Mining sessions are a structured, opt-in amplification layer that runs on top of activity-based rewards. They are not the foundation of the earning model; they enhance it. A mining session without an active participation score behind it produces minimal output. Paired with strong platform engagement, mining sessions significantly amplify total earning capacity.

Session Mechanics

Each mining session runs for a fixed 12-hour cycle. Users manually start a session; the session runs in the background and settles automatically when the 12 hours expire. Rewards are calculated at settlement based on the base rate, active boosts during the session, and the user's Participation Score. Settled DROPS are credited to the user's Earning Balance.

Phase 1 — Onboarding Mining

Days 1–30 From Account Creation

New users receive free mining access as a starter reward. No DROPS spend is required to begin earning. This window is strictly time-based: it expires exactly 30 days from the account creation date regardless of sessions completed or total amount earned.

Days 1–15 · Full Rate

  • Mining runs at the platform's full base rate
  • No boost or prior spend required to start
  • Up to 2 sessions per day at full rate
  • Boosts can be applied to multiply output further
  • Referral bonuses are active from day one

Days 16–30 · Reduced Rate

  • Mining continues at a stepped-down base rate (–70% without a boost)
  • Designed as a transition period, not a penalty
  • Boosted users experience only a –10% reduction — nearly full rate preserved
  • Encourages exploration of promotions, tasks, and tipping
  • Referral bonuses remain active throughout

Onboarding Expiry

Free mining access terminates exactly 30 days after account creation. This is a starter reward system, not a permanent emission channel. After day 30, accounts automatically transition to the Sustained Mining model described below. The expiry cannot be paused, extended, or reset.

Phase 2 — Sustained Mining

Day 31 Onwards

After onboarding, users enter the sustained earning model. Two paths are available. Both paths are governed by an activity score that reflects genuine platform participation; passive accounts earn significantly less regardless of boost status.

Path A — Activity Mining

Earn DROPS purely through platform engagement. No spend required.

  • Earning rate scales with your daily activity score
  • Activity includes: posting, commenting, liking, Drop Call participation, and campaign task completions
  • High-activity users earn at a measurably higher rate than low-activity users in the same session window
  • Periods of complete inactivity reduce the session output proportionally
  • Reward output is dynamic — it reflects real engagement, not time alone

Path B — Boosted Mining

Spend DROPS to amplify your earning potential on top of your activity score.

  • Purchase boost packages that add a percentage multiplier to your base session rate
  • Each boost lasts 24 active mining hours — the budget pauses between sessions and carries forward to the next
  • Each purchase adds +40% to your active boost — build from +40% up to the +400% cap across 10 steps
  • Activity score still applies — boosts amplify activity rewards , they do not replace them
  • Rewards remain dynamic — output is never fixed or guaranteed

Boost Multiplier Steps

Boosts are purchased in increments of +40% per step , with a hard cap of +400% across 10 steps. Each step purchased provides 24 active mining hours of budget at that step's added percentage. Steps are additive — your total active boost is the sum of all steps with remaining budget. Unused budget is never lost at session end; it pauses and carries forward to the next session.

Example: at 10 steps (+400%), a 12-hour session at a 7 DROPS/hr rate yields a base of 84 DROPS × 5 = 420 DROPS , subject to activity score and platform pool conditions at settlement.

Economic Controls

No guaranteed returns Reward output varies with session conditions, activity score, and platform pool health at settlement time

Daily emission ceiling Total DROPS distributed across all miners per day is capped platform-wide and adjusts based on pool conditions

Adjustable base rate The platform base mining rate is a governed parameter that may be adjusted to maintain emission sustainability as the active user count changes

09 — Dual-Balance Wallet

Algorithm-Governed. Stability by Design.

Every Drops App wallet holds two separate balances. The boundary between them is not a flat time-lock or a fixed rate; it is governed dynamically by each user's Participation Score. The more actively a user contributes to the platform, the faster their earned rewards become liquid. This is not a restriction; it is the platform's most powerful anti-dump mechanism and its clearest statement that activity, not capital, is the primary driver of economic access.

The Release Schedule Is Earned, Not Fixed

The Participation Score algorithm continuously evaluates each user's engagement across content creation, community activity, live sessions, tipping, referrals, and verification status. This score produces a release eligibility percentage — the portion of that user's Earning Balance that is due for conversion to Token Balance in a given period. A highly active creator with a strong score sees a larger, faster release. An inactive account holding tokens but contributing nothing sees a slower, smaller release. There is no flat schedule that applies equally to everyone. The algorithm is the schedule.

Earning Balance

DROPS Earned

  • Accumulates from platform activity, mining sessions, tips received, campaign completions, and referral bonuses
  • Not instantly liquid — subject to algorithm-governed conversion based on Participation Score
  • Cannot be directly spent, transferred, or withdrawn — must first be converted to Token Balance
  • Conversion rate is higher for active, high-scoring users and lower for passive or low-engagement accounts
  • Protects the ecosystem from sudden sell pressure regardless of how many users settle rewards simultaneously

Token Balance

DROPS Token

  • Received from direct DROPS purchases, peer transfers, and converted Earning Balance
  • Fully liquid — can be used, transferred, or withdrawn at any time
  • Used for boost purchases, verification fees, campaign creation, and marketplace (coming soon)
  • Cashout requests are processed from this balance only
  • On-chain transfers to BSC wallets draw from this balance

Why This Is a Headline Economic Strength

When millions of users earn tokens simultaneously — through activity, mining, and tips — the conventional risk is mass simultaneous withdrawal flooding the market. The dual-balance system neutralises this. Conversion is metered individually by each user's activity score, meaning sell pressure is distributed across time and weighted toward the users who earned it most actively. The result is a liquid market that grows smoothly with the platform rather than experiencing dump waves at every reward cycle. For investors, this is not a feature — it is the core anti-inflation mechanism that makes the DROPS economy sustainable at scale.

10.2 — Emission Model

DROPS enter circulation from one source only: the Community Reward Pool — a fixed 40,000,000 DROPS allocated at genesis. No new tokens are ever minted. Every DROPS distributed to any user, for any reason, comes out of this single pool.

Distribution Is Based on Rank, Not Time

The Participation Score algorithm continuously ranks every user based on their activity across the platform. At each distribution cycle, the pool releases its daily allowance and divides it among eligible users in proportion to their rank. Higher-ranked users — those who create content, engage genuinely, tip other creators, host sessions, and refer active participants — receive a larger share. Passive accounts receive significantly less. Simply being present does not guarantee a meaningful share of the pool.

Insider allocations (team, growth, development fund) have separate cliff and vesting periods enforced by smart contract. They draw from their own fixed allocations and do not affect the Community Pool ceiling or the daily emission cap. See §10.5 for the full vesting schedule.

10.3 — Demand Drivers

DROPS are not just earned; they are continuously required. Spend categories are split by driver type: Core drivers that any growth-oriented user must engage with, and Transactional drivers that generate demand through everyday platform activity.

Core Demand — Recurring Users who want growth must spend DROPS here

Mining Boosts

Any user seeking to meaningfully grow their mining output must purchase boost packages, renewable every 24 active mining hours. This is the single largest and most predictable recurring demand driver in the ecosystem. Demand scales directly with the active miner count.

Verified Membership Subscription

Creators and users who want elevated visibility, verified trust, and access to premium features must maintain a monthly DROPS subscription. As the platform grows, the verified tier becomes increasingly essential for competitive reach, driving compounding monthly demand.

Promotional Campaigns

Brands, businesses, and creators who want real audience growth must deposit DROPS upfront before any campaign activates. Campaign budgets are locked on creation; every activated campaign represents committed, non-reversible token demand.

Marketplace Transactions Coming Soon

Creator stores, AI tools, and escrow-settled trades all require DROPS. At launch, this adds an entirely new mandatory spend category that reaches beyond the existing miner and creator base to pull in a new buyer segment.

Transactional Demand — Daily Activity Organic circulation from everyday platform use

Post & Profile Boosts

Users spend DROPS to promote posts or boost profile visibility. Each boost is a direct spend event that creates fee revenue and demand simultaneously, and repeats with every new post a creator wants to surface.

Drop Call Tipping

Listeners tip hosts and speakers directly during live sessions using DROPS. As the creator economy matures, recurring live events generate consistent daily tip volume from engaged listener communities, driven entirely by audience engagement rather than access fees.

Content Lifecycle Actions

Any time a user chooses to extend a post's visibility, restore an archived post, or permanently unlock a piece of content, DROPS are spent. These are small, recurring transactions tied to normal creator behaviour — users who post consistently will encounter this spend category regularly, generating organic demand independent of mining or campaign activity.

10.4 — Deflation Mechanism

One Rule. No Exceptions.

20% of every DROPS fee or spend transaction is burned permanently on-chain. This applies across every spend event on the platform without exception — mining boosts, verification subscriptions, campaign deposits, cashout fees, content lifecycle actions, tip commissions, marketplace transactions. Every single one. The burn happens at the point of transaction, is irreversible, and reduces the circulating supply immediately. There is no schedule, no batch process, and no minimum threshold. Spend happens, burn happens. As platform activity scales, the total volume of burns grows with it — against a supply cap that can never increase.

10.6 — Economic Stability Mechanisms

A credible token economy must account for stress scenarios, not just growth scenarios. The following mechanisms are built into the platform to maintain stability when user growth spikes, revenue fluctuates, or mining volume surges beyond normal ranges.

Scenario: Rapid User Growth Spike

If the active miner count increases sharply (for example, during a viral growth event), total session volume rises but the daily emission ceiling does not. Each miner's individual reward is automatically diluted proportionally as the pool is shared across more participants. There is no scenario in which a sudden influx of users causes the platform to emit more DROPS than the ceiling permits. Growth in users does not equal growth in supply.

Scenario: Revenue Decline

If platform revenue drops (due to lower campaign spend or reduced cashout volume), the emission ceiling adjusts downward in proportion. The reward pool is not subsidised by external debt or token minting. If less flows in through fees and platform activity, less flows out through rewards. The system is self-balancing: it cannot pay out more than the economy can sustainably support at any given time.

Scenario: Mass Simultaneous Cashout Pressure

If a large number of users attempt to cash out simultaneously, the dual-balance metering system acts as a rate-limiter at the individual level; Earning Balance conversion is governed, not instant. Cashout fees apply at each withdrawal, and a portion of those fees is burned. Mass cashout events therefore simultaneously reduce circulating supply (through burns) and slow the conversion rate (through the dual-balance mechanism), creating a natural circuit breaker against dump waves.

Scenario: Community Pool Depletion Risk

As the Community Reward Pool (40M DROPS) is distributed over time, the emission rate automatically tapers as the remaining balance shrinks. When circulating supply exceeds 80% of the hard cap, the auto-taper mechanism reduces daily distribution further. This creates a long, gradual emission tail rather than a sharp cliff, giving the platform time to transition miners toward activity-based rewards and marketplace-driven token demand before the pool is fully distributed.

11 — Value Accrual Model

Why DROPS Gains Value Over Time

A token gains value when demand for it grows faster than supply. Drops App is designed so that every dimension of platform growth (more users, more activity, more features, more revenue) directly increases token demand while supply is simultaneously being reduced through burns and controlled emission.

Token Flow Model — What Goes In, What Comes Out

Two forces shape the DROPS supply at all times: a ranked distribution system that controls what comes in, and a universal burn rule that governs what goes out. They do not balance each other — outflows are designed to outpace inflows over time.

Inflows — How DROPS Enter Circulation

DROPS are distributed from the Community Reward Pool to users based on their Participation Score rank. At each cycle, the daily pool allowance is divided among eligible users in proportion to their rank. The more actively a user contributes — through content, engagement, tipping, sessions, referrals, and campaigns — the larger their share. Passive accounts receive little to nothing.

The Community Reward Pool is the only source of DROPS distributed through this ranked emission system. Its 40,000,000 DROPS are the platform's total earning allocation — separate from the remaining supply reserved for liquidity, team vesting, growth, and platform operations. The daily release from this pool is capped and cannot be exceeded. Across all allocations, the total fixed supply is 100,000,000 DROPS. No new tokens can ever be minted.

40M earning pool distributed by rank. 100M total supply, fixed forever. No minting.

Outflows — How DROPS Leave Circulation

20% of every DROPS fee or spend transaction is burned permanently on-chain. This is a single universal rule that applies to every spend event without exception — boosts, verification, campaigns, cashout fees, tips, lifecycle actions, marketplace transactions. Every time DROPS is spent anywhere on the platform, one fifth of it is gone forever.

The remaining 80% is split between platform operations and the Community Reward Pool, sustaining the ecosystem that continues to drive spending. Burns are immediate, irreversible, and have no upper bound — they scale with every new user and every new transaction.

20% burned on every spend. Permanent. Constant. Forever.

Why Outflows Win Over Time

Inflows are hard-capped at 40M DROPS total and slow down automatically as the pool depletes. Outflows have no ceiling — every new user, every new transaction, and every new feature adds more burn events. A platform with ten times the users burns ten times as much. The inflow side cannot keep up by design. This structural gap between a bounded source and an unbounded drain is the mechanism behind long-term supply reduction and value accrual.

Structural Utility Demand

Every meaningful action on Drops App costs DROPS: boosts, verification, campaigns, Drop Call tips, marketplace transactions. This creates demand that is structural (tied to feature usage) rather than speculative. As the platform grows from thousands to millions of users, the aggregate daily DROPS demand from these actions grows proportionally. Platform growth directly translates to token demand growth.

Continuous Supply Reduction

Cashout fee burns, partial boost burns, and transaction fee burns permanently remove DROPS from circulation every day. Unlike inflation-adjusted rebasing models, Drops App burns are absolute and irreversible. Against a fixed 100M cap with no minting, even modest daily burn rates compound into meaningful supply reduction over months and years of platform operation.

Spending Loops

Users earn DROPS through mining and activity, then spend those same DROPS to earn more effectively. Every boost purchase creates demand. Every tip creates a platform fee. Every campaign creates service revenue. These loops mean that the same tokens cycle through spending categories multiple times, creating demand that exceeds what the raw user count would suggest at first glance.

Marketplace as a Demand Multiplier

The forthcoming Marketplace adds creator stores, AI tools, and escrow trades, all settled in DROPS. At launch, this introduces an entirely new category of DROPS spend that does not depend on mining or social engagement. Users who have never mined a single DROPS token may still need to purchase DROPS to access marketplace features, broadening the buyer base significantly.

Controlled Sell Pressure

The dual-balance system meters the conversion of earned DROPS into liquid tokens. Cashout fees add a friction cost to immediate extraction. Together, these mechanisms spread sell pressure over time rather than concentrating it at settlement windows, preventing the price crashes common to earn-to-dump models and maintaining price stability that makes the token attractive to hold rather than immediately sell.

The Direct Summary

The more people use Drops App, the more DROPS they need to use it. The more DROPS are spent, the more are burned or removed through fees. The more are burned against a fixed 100M cap, the scarcer the supply becomes. Scarcer supply plus growing, structurally-driven demand equals rising value. This is the designed outcome of a deliberately constructed token economy.

01 — Resumen

Una nueva economía social

Drops App es una plataforma social de próxima generación donde la creación de contenido, el compromiso genuino y la participación comunitaria son las principales fuentes de recompensa económica. Cada publicación, interacción, sugerencia, llamada en vivo y contribución construye la posición de un usuario en la plataforma, y ​​esa posición gobierna directamente cuánto gana y qué tan rápido sus recompensas se vuelven líquidas. Esta economía está impulsada por DROPS, un token de utilidad deflacionario en BNB Smart Chain con un suministro máximo fijo de 100.000.000 de tokens.

Proposición central

Las plataformas sociales tradicionales generan miles de millones de dólares en ingresos a partir de la atención y los datos de los usuarios, sin devolver nada a las personas que crean ese valor, y al mismo tiempo censuran, prohíben en la sombra o eliminan a los usuarios de la plataforma sin el debido proceso. Drops App rediseña esta relación por completo. Los usuarios participan en una plataforma donde el compromiso genuino genera una recompensa económica real, la moderación del contenido es impulsada por la comunidad y no por algoritmos corporativos, y la censura cero es un principio fundamental, no una promesa. Los ingresos de la plataforma impulsan la demanda de tokens, y la mecánica deflacionaria protege el valor de cada token en circulación tanto para los usuarios como para los poseedores.

Para usuarios

Gana DROPS creando contenido, interactuando con la comunidad, organizando sesiones en vivo, recibiendo consejos y completando tareas de la plataforma. Su rango de actividad, calculado continuamente por el algoritmo de la plataforma, determina su tasa de ganancias y la rapidez con la que su saldo se vuelve líquido. Las sesiones de minería proporcionan una capa de amplificación adicional además de las recompensas basadas en actividades.

Para inversores

Un token de suministro fijo (100M DROPS, sin acuñación adicional) con demanda de utilidad real en seis categorías de gasto, mecánica de quema incorporada en cada tarifa importante y un sistema de doble equilibrio que mide la presión de venta a medida que aumenta la base de usuarios.

Para el ecosistema

Una plataforma de múltiples ingresos que genera ingresos a partir de interacciones sociales, impulsos de minería, campañas, tarifas de retiro y un mercado próximo, en el que cada flujo de ingresos refuerza la demanda de tokens y la sostenibilidad de la plataforma de financiación.

02 — El problema

Lo que no funciona en las redes sociales

La industria mundial de las redes sociales generó más de 200 mil millones de dólares en ingresos publicitarios en 2023. Los usuarios que produjeron el contenido que atrajo esa publicidad no recibieron nada de eso. Este es el problema fundamental que Drops App está diseñado para resolver.

Los usuarios son el producto, no el beneficiario

Plataformas como Meta y TikTok monetizan la atención de los usuarios mediante publicidad y licencias de datos. En 2023, Meta generó aproximadamente 134 dólares por usuario anualmente en ingresos. Los usuarios no recibieron ninguna parte de esto a pesar de ser la única fuente del contenido que lo genera.

Censura, prohibición de sombras y control algorítmico

En la mayoría de las plataformas, un solo moderador o un algoritmo automatizado puede suprimir silenciosamente el alcance de un creador, eliminar su contenido o prohibir su cuenta por completo, sin un proceso transparente, sin aportes de la comunidad y sin un derecho de apelación significativo. La prohibición oculta elimina la visibilidad sin siquiera notificar al usuario lo que ha sucedido. Este poder de censura desenfrenado crea un ambiente hostil donde los creadores se autocensuran en lugar de expresarse libremente.

Sin verdadera propiedad del contenido o la audiencia

Las cuentas de creadores se suspenden sin apelación. El alcance algorítmico se limita arbitrariamente. Los programas de monetización se revocan a discreción de la plataforma. El contenido se elimina silenciosamente según cronogramas que los usuarios nunca aceptaron y de los que nunca se les informó. Los usuarios construyen audiencias sobre infraestructura que no les pertenece y que no pueden transferir, lo que los deja con carreras frágiles y dependientes de la plataforma.

Experimentos inflacionarios de ganancia por uso

Las plataformas anteriores con economías simbólicas introdujeron la oferta sin controles, requisitos de actividad o utilidad real. Los tokens extraídos libremente sin mecanismo de quema y sin impulsores de demanda colapsaron en valor cuando la oferta superó la demanda orgánica. Los usuarios obtuvieron tokens que valían cada vez menos con el tiempo.

Agricultura de bots y explotación pasiva

Cualquier modelo de ganar mientras se usa sin requisitos de actividad se vuelve vulnerable al cultivo de bots: cuentas automatizadas que agotan el suministro de tokens sin contribuir con un valor social genuino, perjudicando a los usuarios reales y degradando la economía de los tokens para todos.

03 — Nuestra Visión

Una plataforma que funciona para usted

Drops App se basa en un principio único: la participación debe crear valor duradero. Cada función genera ingresos de la plataforma, demanda de tokens o recompensas para el usuario y, en la mayoría de los casos, las tres simultáneamente.

El bucle central

Los usuarios se unen y ganan DROPS creando contenido, interactuando con la comunidad y participando en la actividad de la plataforma. Su puntuación de participación rige su tasa de ganancias y la velocidad de liberación del saldo de ganancias. Gastan DROPS para ampliar el alcance, acceder a funciones premium y aumentar la producción minera. El gasto genera ingresos de la plataforma y reduce el suministro de tokens. Una economía más sana atrae a más usuarios, más actividad, más demanda, más quemaduras. El bucle se agrava con el tiempo.

Cero censura por diseño

Drops App se basa en una filosofía de cero censura. Ningún algoritmo suprime el contenido. Ningún moderador prohíbe a un usuario de forma invisible. Ninguna decisión corporativa silencia a un creador. La moderación de contenido en Drops App está totalmente impulsada por la comunidad: los usuarios informan, la comunidad de embajadores vota y las decisiones se escalan a través de un proceso de gobernanza transparente antes de que se tome cualquier acción. A medida que la plataforma crece, este modelo evoluciona hacia una DAO (Organización Autónoma Descentralizada) completa donde la comunidad tiene poder de gobernanza directo sobre los estándares de moderación. La libertad de expresión y la soberanía comunitaria son valores no negociables en cada etapa del desarrollo de la plataforma.
